Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). ## writing_plan.yaml — contamcal-irt-calibration
## Generated: 2026-05-15 | Paper Agent Step 1
## Status: APPROVED (Director 2026-05-15)

meta:
  venue: "EMNLP 2026 ARR May 25"
  track: "Machine Learning for NLP / Resources and Evaluation"
  deadline: "2026-05-25"
  page_limit: 8  # + unlimited appendix
  template: "acl_latex (ARR format)"
  template_note: "No local EMNLP 2026 template found; use acl-style-files from github.com/acl-org/acl-style-files. Worker should download latest."
  special_theme: "New Missions for NLP Research"
  framing_doc: "paper_framing.md (D039 pivot: characterization-led)"
  total_word_budget: 5800  # main text excluding references

title: >
  ContamCal: Characterizing Benchmark-Dependent Contamination Effects
  via Contamination-Augmented Item Response Theory

core_claims:
  C1:
    name: "Characterization (PRIMARY)"
    summary: "Contamination effects are benchmark-dependent (ARC γ<0, GSM8K γ>0) and scale-dependent (catastrophic at 0.5B, mild at 3B). Per-benchmark γ_k captures bidirectional effects."
    evidence: [exp-001, exp-006]
    priority: 1
  C2:
    name: "Signal Failure (CO-PRIMARY)"
    summary: "Min-K++ directional reversal (Cohen's d = -1.98 at 0.5B d100). S1 embedding is the only reliable signal (AUC>0.95 at d005). RRF degrades to S1-only in practice."
    evidence: [exp-008, exp-002, exp-003]
    priority: 1
  C3:
    name: "Identifiability"
    summary: "Fisher Information analysis → recovery successful at AUC=0.55 (lowest tested, J≥50); lower bound open. LLM eval small cohorts create domain-method mismatch."
    evidence: [exp-004, mvp_sim_4pl_gamma]
    priority: 2
  C4:
    name: "Conditional Calibration (DEMOTED)"
    summary: "Calibration works when model complexity matches benchmark + signal AUC sufficient. ARC MAE=0.035. GSM8K overcorrection as honest negative result. Gating criterion necessary."
    evidence: [exp-006]
    priority: 3

paper_outline:
  abstract:
    word_budget: 200
    dependencies: [introduction, results, conclusion]
    key_numbers: ["ARC γ=-1.46", "GSM8K γ=3.77 (oracle)", "Min-K++ Cohen's d=-1.98", "ARC MAE=0.035", "AUC=0.55 recovery (lowest tested)"]
    notes: "Write last. Characterization-led framing. 4 claims in priority order."

  introduction:
    word_budget: 850
    dependencies: [method, results]
    subsections:
      - "Problem: contamination undermines benchmark reliability"
      - "Gap: detection methods flag but don't calibrate; mitigation provably fails"
      - "Our approach: characterization framework via contamination-augmented IRT"
      - "3 core contributions (characterization, signal failure, identifiability) + conditional calibration"
    notes: "D039 pivot: lead with characterization, not calibration. Frame as diagnostic framework. Reference Emperor's New Clothes for motivation."

  related_work:
    word_budget: 700
    dependencies: [literature_map]
    subsections:
      - "Contamination detection (Min-K++, ConStat, KDS, CDD, Self-Critique)"
      - "IRT for LLM evaluation (Lalor, TinyBenchmarks, Growing Pains, HiBayES)"
      - "Item compromise in educational measurement (Eckerly, Sinharay, DIF)"
      - "Contamination mitigation and calibration disambiguation"
    notes: "Must disambiguate 'calibration' from probability calibration (Guo et al.) and conformal prediction."

  method:
    word_budget: 1100
    dependencies: []
    subsections:
      - name: "3.1 Problem Formulation"
        content: "Given model j, benchmark k with items i, observed response y_{ijk}. Goal: estimate θ_j^clean. Three IRT adaptations from educational measurement."
      - name: "3.2 Stage 1: Multi-Signal Exposure Mapping"
        content: "4 signals (S1-S4), RRF aggregation. Meta-circularity argument for training-free fusion."
      - name: "3.3 Stage 2: Contamination-Augmented IRT"
        content: "4PL+γ model: P(y=1) = c_i + (d_i - c_i) σ(a_i(θ_j - b_i) + γ_k·e_{ij}). Per-benchmark γ_k. Stan NUTS inference."
      - name: "3.4 Fisher Information and Identifiability"
        content: "Derive I(γ) for 4PL+γ. Recovery boundaries from sim sweep (24 conditions, 240 runs). CI width ∝ N^{-0.48}. Domain-method mismatch."
    notes: "Can be written first (no data dependency). Include measurement error model as optional extension. Full Fisher derivation in appendix."

  experimental_setup:
    word_budget: 600
    dependencies: [method]
    subsections:
      - name: "4.1 Controlled SFT Injection"
        content: "Qwen2.5 (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B). 4 dosages (d000/d005/d025/d100). 2 seeds. LoRA alpha=32. QC-filtered injection data."
      - name: "4.2 Benchmarks and Evaluation Protocol"
        content: "ARC-Challenge (1172 items), GSM8K (1319), MMLU (14042, subsampled for IRT). 6 metrics. Aligned + paraphrased eval."
      - name: "4.3 Baselines"
        content: "7 baselines: B0-Raw, B1-Remove&Rescore, B2-Single2PL+γ, B3-Vanilla4PL, B4-LinearRegression, B5-Emperor, B6-DCR."
    notes: "D045: exclude 0.5B MMLU/ARC from IRT pooling (position bias). Retain 0.5B GSM8K. D060: scope to 0.5B+1.5B main, 3B as [PENDING-3B]. 7B/72B → future work."

  results:
    word_budget: 1500
    dependencies: [experimental_setup, fig_signal_heatmap, fig_dose_response, fig_identifiability, fig_calibration, table_gamma, table_baselines]
    subsections:
      - name: "5.1 Contamination Characterization"
        content: "Per-benchmark γ_k: ARC γ=-1.46 (forgetting), GSM8K γ=3.77 (oracle, inflation). Scale modulation: 0.5B catastrophic vs 1.5B mild. Dose-response curves. 3B [PENDING-3B]."
        claims: [C1]
        key_tables: [table_gamma]
        key_figures: [fig_dose_response]
      - name: "5.2 Detection Signal Analysis"
        content: "S1 AUC>0.95 at d005. S2 Min-K++ AUC~0.47, Cohen's d=-1.98 (reversal). S4 random. RRF = S1-only in practice."
        claims: [C2]
        key_tables: [table_signal_summary]
        key_figures: [fig_signal_heatmap]
      - name: "5.3 Identifiability Boundaries"
        content: "Sim sweep (24 conditions, 240 runs): AUC=0.80 N=50 bias=0.006. AUC=0.55 J≥50 meets all criteria. AUC=0.65 systematically fails at small J. CI width ∝ N^{-0.48}. LLM eval small cohorts = structural mismatch."
        claims: [C3]
        key_figures: [fig_identifiability]
      - name: "5.4 Conditional Calibration"
        content: "ARC 4PL+γ: MAE=0.035 (beats all baselines). Kendall τ=0.756. Coverage 62.5% (below nominal). GSM8K signal-derived γ non-significant → gating criterion triggers. GSM8K overcorrection MAE=0.092 vs raw 0.005 as honest negative. MMLU IRT fails (Rhat=1.54)."
        claims: [C4]
        key_tables: [table_baselines]
        key_figures: [fig_calibration]
    notes: "3B rows in all tables/figures marked [PENDING-3B]. Honest about negatives: GSM8K overcorrection, MMLU failure, coverage below nominal."

  discussion:
    word_budget: 500
    dependencies: [results]
    subsections:
      - "Limitations: single model family (Qwen2.5), SFT ≠ real contamination, N<50, coverage below nominal"
      - "0.5B position bias (D045): capacity threshold for MC evaluation"
      - "When NOT to calibrate: gating criterion and its implications"
      - "Future work: multi-family (Llama/Pythia), 7B+, RL observational, data attribution signals"
    notes: "Coverage collapse (D056) as model misspecification evidence. noise_prop negative result → appendix mention."

  conclusion:
    word_budget: 350
    dependencies: [discussion]
    notes: "Restate 4 claims compactly. Emphasize characterization > calibration. End with 'conditions under which calibration is feasible' framing."

  appendix:
    sections:
      - name: "A: Fisher Information Derivation"
        source: "artifacts/fisher_info_derivation/fisher_info_appendix.tex"
        notes: "Already drafted. Verify completeness."
      - name: "B: Simulation Sweep Details"
        data_source: "exp-004"
      - name: "C: Measurement Error Analysis"
        data_source: "exp-005"
        notes: "Negative result. noise_prop_v4 CI insensitive to σ_e."
      - name: "D: 0.5B Position Bias Analysis"
        data_source: "exp-001 (0.5B MMLU prediction distribution)"
        notes: "D045: MMLU prediction dist d000 A=46% → d100 A=98%."
      - name: "E: HumanEval Results"
        notes: "Demoted from main (D009: 16% QC pass)."

visualization_plan:
  fig_pipeline:
    type: "conceptual_diagram"
    description: "ContamCal 2-stage pipeline overview. Left: 4 detection signals → RRF fusion → exposure scores. Right: exposure + responses → 4PL+γ IRT → calibrated scores with CIs. Show per-benchmark γ_k."
    placement: "Section 3 (Method), top of page"
    aspect_ratio: "2:1 (wide)"
    tool: "matplotlib"
    data_source: null  # conceptual, no data
    output: "figures/paper/fig_pipeline.pdf"

  fig_dose_response:
    type: "line_plot"
    description: "Dosage (x: d000, d005, d025, d100) vs benchmark accuracy (y) for each benchmark. Separate panels or lines for 0.5B, 1.5B, [PENDING-3B]. Show ARC forgetting vs GSM8K inflation. Error bars from 2 seeds."
    placement: "Section 5.1"
    aspect_ratio: "3:2"
    tool: "matplotlib"
    data_source: "registry: exp-001 eval results (aligned format, all scales × dosages × seeds)"
    output: "figures/paper/fig_dose_response.pdf"

  fig_signal_heatmap:
    type: "heatmap"
    description: "Signal AUC heatmap. Rows: 3 signals (S1 Embedding, S2 Min-K++, S4 Self-Critique) × 3 benchmarks. Columns: dosages (d005, d025). Separate panels for 0.5B and 1.5B. Annotate Cohen's d for d100 cross-model comparison. Highlight Min-K++ reversal cell in red."
    placement: "Section 5.2"
    aspect_ratio: "4:3"
    tool: "matplotlib"
    data_source: "registry: exp-008 signal survival v1 + v4 (AUC + Cohen's d)"
    output: "figures/paper/fig_signal_heatmap.pdf"

  fig_identifiability:
    type: "phase_diagram"
    description: "Identifiability boundaries. X: signal AUC. Y: N_models. Color/marker: γ recovery quality (bias, RMSE, CI coverage). Shade regions: successful recovery region (AUC≥0.55, all tested N≥20). Lower bound open. Mark actual LLM eval operating point (AUC~0.98, N=8-16)."
    placement: "Section 5.3"
    aspect_ratio: "1:1"
    tool: "matplotlib"
    data_source: "registry: exp-004 sim_sweep results (v5 completed conditions)"
    output: "figures/paper/fig_identifiability.pdf"

  fig_calibration:
    type: "scatter_with_ci"
    description: "Calibrated score (x) vs true clean score (y) scatter. Each point = one model-benchmark. Horizontal bars = 95% CI. Diagonal = perfect calibration. Color by benchmark. Annotate ARC cluster (good) vs GSM8K cluster (overcorrection). Include B0 (raw) as hollow markers for comparison."
    placement: "Section 5.4"
    aspect_ratio: "1:1"
    tool: "matplotlib"
    data_source: "registry: exp-006 IRT calibration results (ARC S1-only 4PL+γ, GSM8K 2PL+γ)"
    output: "figures/paper/fig_calibration.pdf"

table_plan:
